version.changelog: 通用家庭维修助手：家电/水电网/家具故障诊断与维修指导，三层方案（自查/DIY/送修），含安全规范和成本估算

llm.summary: This is a disclosed household repair guidance skill with safety-sensitive content but no hidden execution, credential access, persistence, or data collection.

dimensions.detail: The skill provides appliance, plumbing, electrical, furniture, and vehicle troubleshooting advice, including DIY and professional-repair options; this is coherent with its stated repair-assistant purpose, though some advice is safety-sensitive.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Activation wording is broad and could route ambiguous repair-like requests to the skill, but the artifact includes a scope table, PC/phone exclusions, clarification steps for vague reports, and required safety warnings.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package consists only of Markdown skill/reference files; metadata and static scan show no executable scripts, package installation steps, or startup hooks.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The only environment-facing behavior is optional public web searching for prices/videos/repair shops if a connector is available and optional user-requested HTML report generation; this is proportionate to the repair-report purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background workers, persistence, privilege escalation, credential/session use, broad local indexing, or automatic mutation behavior is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an advisory home-repair assistant. Treat electrical, gas, microwave, HVAC, high-place, vehicle safety, and chemical guidance as triage information, and use qualified professionals whenever the skill flags high risk or you are not trained for the task.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger keywords are real, but they are disclosed in the manifest and support a general repair assistant; this is a routing-quality concern rather than evidence of hidden or privileged behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The vague activation examples are broader than ideal, but the surrounding instructions require collecting device type, symptoms, history, and context before giving advice.
[SQP-2] expected: The appliance reference includes mains, capacitor, gas, and disassembly topics, which are expected for household repair guidance; the main skill and safety guide add mandatory warnings and professional-only guidance for high-risk cases.
[pre-scan unicode-control-chars] expected: Inspection found formatting characters associated with emoji sequences, not hidden prompt text, bidirectional override deception, or executable content.
